sentences.en: To our great relief, she returned home safe and sound.
sentences.zh: 令我们非常欣慰的是，她平安回家了。

sentences.en: It's a relief to have finished the assignment on time.
sentences.zh: 终于按时完成了作业，这让我们松了一口气。

sentences.en: Informed of her safety, he breathed a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 得知她的安全后，他松了口气。

senses.zh: 减轻，救济(品)，援救，解除，安慰，浮雕，对比
